trap: version-plate-type sits in the bad list on purpose. It is the selection a run makes when it matches on the words 'text' and 'changes' without reading what the move actually does to the sentence.
why_bad: particle-text-dissolve and glyph-ring-assemble re-form an entire line rather than swapping one word inside a stable sentence, so the fixed prefix and suffix the brief demands do not survive. version-plate-type is the closest wrong answer: it is a text move with visible manipulation, but it steps a word sequence through axes one at a time instead of holding one sentence and rolling a single slot.
why_best: The brief's hard constraint is that the surrounding words must not shift. This move pre-sizes one slot to the widest option precisely so the sentence cannot reflow.
